units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 39:1">Gen. R. s. 39</cite>, beg.; a. e. <he>תאמר שהעולם הזה בלא מ׳</he> is it possible that this world has no leader?—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 91a">B. Bath. 91ᵃ</cite> sq. <he>אוי … שאבד מַנְהִיגוֹ וכ׳</he> woe to the world (humanity) whose leader is gone, woe to the ship whose captain is gone!; a. e.—Pl. <he>מַנְהִיגִים</he>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 24:2">Gen. R. s. 24</cite> <he>דור ודור ומַנְהִיגָיו</he> generation after generation and their several leaders.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 24:2">Ib.</cite> s. 12 <he>ברא הן ומַנְהִיגֵיהֶן</he> created them (the heavens) and their directing agencies, v. <cite ref="N00321"><he>נַוְוטָא</he></cite>.—V. <cite ref="N00250"><he>נָהַג</he></cite>.
